editionLabel: Days of Wonder English rules, 2015 file
firstPlayerRule: The most recent person to board a real train starts and takes the miniature whistle. Play goes clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After each round of players' turns, the person who acted last takes the whistle and starts the next round.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://www.daysofwonder.com/other-games/. Finding: The most recent person to board a real train starts and takes the miniature whistle. Play goes clockwise. Local source SHA-256: 0afc07acaaf56e9610e24586ffbcc2e6100d467d254a5bfc450eabe264d4d5a2. The rendered page has printed number 2, even though its layout-production stamp says Page 3. The rulebook uses 'turn' for the full round here; the summary distinguishes that round from one player's action. The three- and four-player adjustments on the same page do not replace the starting criterion.
